Always start by reading [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md), the canonical documentation map. Review domain module docs before changes. Use module owners (or platform team) for cross-cutting approvals. Record architecture decisions as ADRs in `DECISIONS/`.

Ownership: platform—`crates/rustok-core`, `apps/server`, shared infra; domains—`crates/rustok-*`; frontends—`apps/admin`, `apps/storefront`, `apps/next-admin`, `apps/next-frontend`; MCP—`crates/rustok-mcp`; operations—`scripts/`, `docker-compose*.yml`, `grafana/`, `prometheus/`. See [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md).

Central platform docs (`docs/`) are Russian; public contracts, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and crate `README.md` files are English. Mixed language within a document is not allowed—choose one language per file. Platform docs belong in `docs/`; component docs in `apps/<name>/docs/` or `crates/<name>/docs/`. Every app/crate root `README.md` must state purpose, responsibilities, interactions, entry points, and link to `docs/`. `docs/modules/_index.md` links all module docs.

When changing architecture, API, events, modules, tenancy, routing, UI contracts, or observability:
1. Update relevant component docs (`apps/*` or `crates/*`).
2. Update related central docs in `docs/`.
3. Update [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md).
4. For added/renamed modules or apps, update [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md).
5. Mark outdated docs `deprecated` or `archived` and link replacements.

Do not create a new document if a suitable one already exists — extend the existing one.

Mandatory for all automated agents:
1. Always start by reading [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md).
2. Do not create a new document when an existing one is suitable — extend it instead.
3. Documentation must reflect the actual state of the code.
4. Never bypass or disable pre-commit/pre-push hooks. Fix the root cause of failures.
5. Do not edit CI/CD workflow files unless explicitly requested.
6. Do not modify other branches — only work on the assigned task branch.
